title: Cyclone Arnab: red alert Oct 28 for Mulugu, Kothagudem, Khammam; Hyderabad no alert
body: The system should become a severe cyclonic storm by Oct 27 and cross Andhra on Oct 28. Telangana: 3 red, 5 orange and 8 yellow districts. Hyderabad city: light rain or thundershowers, no alert.

steps.b: Depression formed; severe cyclone expected by Oct 27, Andhra crossing Oct 28.
East and northeast Telangana get heavy to very heavy rain on Oct 28.
Private forecaster T Balaji sees light-moderate Hyderabad rain Oct 29–Nov 4.

care: Travel to Khammam or Bhadrachalam on Oct 27–28? Push it if you can.
